'''Pesktda Detention Center''' was a [[Prison/Legends|detention center]] in [[Pesktda]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]].<ref name="GatORW" /> In [[6 ABY/Legends]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the crew of the [[Gymsnor-3 light freighter/Legends|Gymsnor-3 light freighter]] ''[[Star's Delight]]'' were held in the facility for [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] parts and [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] onto the planet. They were [[Great Evacuation|freed]] by a group of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]-sympathetic students led by [[Dynba Tesc]] in a plan devised by former [[Corellian Security Force]] [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].<ref name="MC">{{JournalCite|7|Missed Chance}}</ref>
